message.content: {"note_claim": "On 2022/3/31 Prime Minister Kishida clearly stated Japan would not withdraw from Sakhalin-2.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "岸田文雄首相は３１日の衆院本会議で、日本の大手商社が参画するロシア極東の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン２」について「撤退しない方針だ」と明言した。", "reason": "The Sankei article dated 2022/3/31 directly reports Kishida stating in the Diet that Japan will not withdraw from Sakhalin-2."}

parsed.note_claim: On 2022/3/31 Prime Minister Kishida clearly stated Japan would not withdraw from Sakhalin-2.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 岸田文雄首相は３１日の衆院本会議で、日本の大手商社が参画するロシア極東の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン２」について「撤退しない方針だ」と明言した。
parsed.reason: The Sankei article dated 2022/3/31 directly reports Kishida stating in the Diet that Japan will not withdraw from Sakhalin-2.
